### Booking Holdings Inc. to Present at the Citi 2026 Global TMT Conference


August 25, 2026


NORWALK, Conn.


, Aug. 25, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) today announced that Chief Executive Officer Glenn Fogel will participate in a keynote session at the Citi


2026 Global TMT Conference, held in New York City, on September 8, beginning at 3:55pm ET. A live audio cast of the presentation will be available to the public at[https://ir.bookingholdings.com/events](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4755600-1&h=1468660801&u=https%3A%2F%2Fir.bookingholdings.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2FEvents%2Fdefault.aspx&a=https%3A%2F%2Fir.bookingholdings.com%2Fevents) , and a replay will be available approximately 24 hours later.


Source: Booking Holdings
#BKNG_Corporate


**About Booking Holdings**


Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is the world leader in online travel and services that support the entire travel journey. Our platforms - including[Booking.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4755600-1&h=3067300830&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.booking.com%2F&a=Booking.com) ,[Priceline](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4755600-1&h=2595940294&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.priceline.com%2F&a=Priceline) ,[Agoda](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4755600-1&h=3736003210&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.agoda.com%2F&a=Agoda) ,[KAYAK](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4755600-1&h=537749531&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kayak.com%2F&a=KAYAK) and[OpenTable](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4755600-1&h=1406440964&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.opentable.com%2F&a=OpenTable) - utilize advanced AI, machine learning and other innovative technologies to simplify and personalize the travel experience for consumers and partners in over 220 countries and territories. Our mission is to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. For more information, visit[BookingHoldings.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4755600-1&h=23272144&u=http%3A%2F%2Fbookingholdings.com%2F&a=BookingHoldings.com) and follow us on X @BookingHoldings.
